title: Phase 1.5 Authority, Recompilation, Representation, and Typed-Topology Assay
started_from: existing Phase 1 vault plus sealed 2026-08-23 local architecture assay
scope: local-only metadata, five captured originals, existing crosswalks, and prior assay receipts
methods: connector-oriented entity resolution with explicit unresolved placeholders
typed graph observation validation against ordered edge identifiers
controls: source artifact, archival metadata, and interpretation remain separate
source-declared, archive-inferred, and researcher-proposed relations retain distinct provenance
contradictions and missing ordinals are never automatically repaired
theorem labels never promote authority by themselves
collaborator-reported passages without local spans remain acquisition targets
authority queries return every witnessed time slice; latest publication never controls without an explicit transition edge
placeholder and unresolved entities are terminal connector states rather than invitations to autocomplete scholarship
prior sealed assay outputs remain byte-stable
